findings.title: Canonical finality status contradicts its own README contract
findings.reason: README says the submission is unfinished, that v60/current 1271 and X1v2 512 decisions are pending human work, that review_log.json is pending, and that MANIFEST is pending finalization. MANIFEST line 1 and review_log.json instead declare FINAL. This leaves the formal status ambiguous and can cause unfinished data to be consumed as final.
findings.basis: README.md lines 1, 8, 20-29, 38-41 versus MANIFEST line 1 status=FINAL and review_log.json root /review_status=FINAL with all 1783 entries marked FINAL.
findings.recompute_command: rg -n '当前提交只冻结|1271 条|512 条|review_log.json.*待人工|待最终化|正式出数前必须' derived/manual_adjudication_v2/README.md; rg -o 'status:"[A-Z_]+' derived/manual_adjudication_v2/MANIFEST; jq -r '[.review_status, (.entries|map(.review_status)|group_by(.)|map({status:.[0],count:length}))] | @json' derived/manual_adjudication_v2/review_log.json
findings.evidence_pointer: README lines 1/8/20-29/38-41; MANIFEST line 1; review_log.json line 1
findings.targeted_re_review: Choose one status contract and update all status-bearing files atomically. If data is not actually final, use PROPOSAL/INDEPENDENT_REVIEW and remove FINAL promotion; if final, update README and prove all stated gates. Re-run MANIFEST hash validation and a status-consistency check.
